name: account.me
description: The caller's account, their companies with their role in each, and the brands they reach, read when they sign in.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('user', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(u) - 'role') || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(u.created_at), 'deactivatedAt', brandbase.iso(u.deactivated_at)), 'companies', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', o.id, 'name', o.name, 'role', m.role) order by o.name, o.id) from brandbase.org_members m join brandbase.organizations o on o.id = m.org_id where m.user_id = u.id), '[]'), 'brands', coalesce((select jsonb_agg((brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(b)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(b.created_at))) order by o.name, o.id, b.position, b.id) from brandbase.brands b join brandbase.organizations o on o.id = b.org_id), '[]')) as result from brandbase.users u where u.id = brandbase.caller()
